histogram.name: CBOR.Read.Duration
histogram.summary: Records the total elapsed time in microseconds for cbor::Reader::Read(), which for the Rust parser includes both Rust parsing and the conversion of the result to a C++ cbor::Value. Emitted once for every call to cbor::Reader::Read() that leaves the choice of parser to the kUseRustCborParser feature. Both the C++ and the Rust parser report here, so the two can be compared across that feature's experiment groups. Calls that select a parser themselves are not recorded, and neither is anything in builds that do not include the Rust parser, as neither takes part in the experiment. This metric is also only reported for clients with high-resolution clocks.

histogram.name: CBOR.Read.Result
histogram.summary: Records the outcome (success or specific decoder error) of CBOR parsing operations. Emitted once for every call to cbor::Reader::Read() that leaves the choice of parser to the kUseRustCborParser feature. Both the C++ and the Rust parser report here, so the two can be compared across that feature's experiment groups. Calls that select a parser themselves are not recorded, and neither is anything in builds that do not include the Rust parser, as neither takes part in the experiment.

histogram.name: CBOR.Read.Size
histogram.summary: Records the size of the payload in bytes provided to cbor::Reader::Read(). This provides context for CBOR.Read.Duration. Sizes above 10MB are recorded in the overflow bucket. Emitted once for every call to cbor::Reader::Read() that leaves the choice of parser to the kUseRustCborParser feature. Both the C++ and the Rust parser report here, so the two can be compared across that feature's experiment groups. Calls that select a parser themselves are not recorded, and neither is anything in builds that do not include the Rust parser, as neither takes part in the experiment.

histogram.name: CBOR.Write.Duration
histogram.summary: Records the elapsed time for cbor::Writer::Write() (including C++-to-Rust value conversion when using the Rust writer), for both successful and failed calls. Emitted once per call controlled by kUseRustCborWriter in builds with the Rust writer enabled, on clients with high-resolution clocks.

histogram.name: CBOR.Write.Size
histogram.summary: Records the output size in bytes of successful cbor::Writer::Write() calls (capped at 10MB). Emitted once per successful call controlled by kUseRustCborWriter in builds with the Rust writer enabled.

histogram.name: CBOR.Write.Success
histogram.summary: Records whether cbor::Writer::Write() succeeded. Emitted once per call controlled by kUseRustCborWriter in builds with the Rust writer enabled.
